note: Real source-window pool for prompt-driven selection. candidate70/162/2216 are a night motorcycle-cut-in family; candidate1409 is a night pedestrian-crossing window built with the same pipeline (scan -> identity probe -> runtime subset -> baseline). With the pedestrian window added, ranking now separates by requested object: a pedestrian prompt selects candidate1409, a motorcycle prompt selects a motorcycle window. Each entry carries source_from_baseline_dir so the selected window's binding is read byte-exact from its baseline directory. More scenarios (truck, daytime, fog) extend this further.
